subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 4 — Structured Analysis, Hierarchical Data Flow Modeling & Logic Specifications
moduleDescription: Comprehensive examination of Structured Analysis methodologies, the three orthogonal system views (Functional, Data, Dynamic), hierarchical Data Flow Diagrams (Context Diagram Level 0, Level 1 Subsystem Decomposition, and Level 2 Functional Primitives), flow conservation invariants (Black Hole, Miracle Source, and Grey Hole anti-patterns), Data Dictionary architecture and composite algebraic metadata grammars, and rigorous logic modeling through Decision Trees, 2^N complete Decision Tables, and Structured English Process Specifications (P-Specs).
